title: Allow manually sending all persistent notifications to the history
line: Every notification that stays on screen until you act on it now has a Minimize button that tucks it into the notification history.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.4 a notification popup gets a Minimize button only when it is both persistent (no timeout) and resident, so ordinary persistent notifications, like a Chrome extension's code review alerts, could only be closed, never set aside. They stayed on top of windows until the user acted on them. The change makes every persistent notification minimizable; the tray's bell and its 'N active notifications' tooltip now count any minimized notification, not only resident ones, so it stays visible in the panel until it's handled or restored.

commits.message:
notifications: allow minimizing every persistent notification

Only resident notifications without a timeout could be minimized to the
history, so other notifications that stay on screen until acted upon had
to be closed to get them out of the way. Allow it for all of them.

BUG: 503514

media.caption: Pure master: a persistent Konsole notification (timeout 0) only offers Configure and Close
Same notification with the fix: a Minimize button next to Close
Pure master: the popup keeps covering the screen; it's in the history but can only be closed
After Minimize: the popup is gone, the bell shows in the tray and the history entry has a Restore button

review.text: Clean, minimal fix in libnotificationmanager that directly implements Nate's retitle by dropping the resident requirement from DismissableRole so all persistent (timeout == 0) notifications can be minimized to and restored from history. Updating Notifications::Private::updateCount() to filter by Notifications::NotificationType properly avoids double-counting minimized jobs alongside activeJobsCount, while keeping the public dismissedResidentNotificationsCount property name preserves API/ABI compatibility. Before/after screenshots and verification convincingly demonstrate the Minimize/Restore flow and tray bell indicator without regressions.

reviews.text: Clean, minimal fix in libnotificationmanager that directly implements Nate's retitle by dropping the resident requirement from DismissableRole so all persistent (timeout == 0) notifications can be minimized to and restored from history. Updating Notifications::Private::updateCount() to filter by Notifications::NotificationType properly avoids double-counting minimized jobs alongside activeJobsCount, while keeping the public dismissedResidentNotificationsCount property name preserves API/ABI compatibility. Before/after screenshots and verification convincingly demonstrate the Minimize/Restore flow and tray bell indicator without regressions.

Dropping the resident requirement from DismissableRole is the right, minimal direction for Nate's retitled request, and critical notifications are covered since libnotificationmanager forces their timeout to 0; the count change (any minimized non-job notification) is consistent. But a minimized notification is only reachable through the history model, which filters by the per-app 'Show in history' blacklist and drops low-urgency notifications by default (and, per the fixer's own rig note, some apps without a desktop entry). Before, only rare resident notifications could fall into that hole; now every persistent popup from such an app gets a Minimize button that makes it vanish from screen and history alike, while the app still considers it open, and the bell count doesn't see it either. The evidence covers only the happy path with Konsole.
changes: Make sure a minimized notification can always be restored: either let the history model always show dismissed, non-expired notifications regardless of the history blacklist/low-urgency filters, or only offer Minimize when the notification will actually appear in the history.
Verify Minimize/Restore with a persistent notification from an app whose 'Show in history' is off and with a low-urgency timeout-0 notification.
Consider decoupling the Minimize button for normal notifications from the job-only 'keep job popups visible' setting, or say in the commit message that it stays tied to it.
